name: Bright Plate
description: The first plate at 1.8 seconds with the highs ringing as long as the middle: a bright plate for vocals and snares.

name: Drum Ambience
description: The ambience program at under a second: a dense burst of early reflections and a short quiet tail. Puts a dry kit in a room without washing it out.

name: Frozen Pad
description: Freeze: what goes in hangs in the loop for as long as it plays. Under a pad or a drone.

name: Gated Kick
description: Nonlin short and dark, at 150 ms with the highs cut: a kick that grows without a tail.

name: Gated Snare
description: The gated Nonlin program at 300 ms: a wall of reflections that holds and then stops dead. The big snare of the 1980s.

name: Reverse Swell
description: The reverse program at 400 ms: reflections that swell towards their end and stop, after a snare or a vocal word.

name: Tight Room
description: The first room at under a second, its highs a little short: drums and guitars in a small live room.

name: Vocal Hall
description: The second hall at 2.5 seconds, 40 ms of pre-delay, the bass a little long: a vocal's hall.
